Farklı cihazlardan alınan veriler eş zam: Data from different devices is compared simultaneously to produce accurate generation reports. MPPT/string and inverter performance analysis helps identify sources of loss.

Kompanzasyon Takibi ve Kontrolü: Power Factor Correction Monitoring and Control
Reaktif güç sürekli izlenir; limit aşıml: Reactive power is continuously monitored, with correction controlled automatically when limits are exceeded.
Reaktif güç değerleri sürekli izlenir. L: ScadaWatt continuously monitors reactive power and controls the power factor correction system when limits are exceeded, helping prevent penalty risks.
Saatlik veriler üzerinden fatura doğrula: Electricity bills are checked against hourly data to help detect billing errors.
Tüketim kadar üretim: şebeke yönüne ener: Generate what you consume, without exporting power to the grid.
Zero Injection modülü ile eviriciler din: The Zero Injection module dynamically controls inverters using PID control. Consumption is measured and generation is adjusted to match demand.
Böylece şebeke yönüne enerji gitmemesi s: This prevents power from being exported to the grid. The process is monitored and managed through ScadaWatt screens and reports.
Planlı üretim durdurma modülü ile yük at: The scheduled generation curtailment module automates load shedding, applying instructions to the site without manual intervention.
PRO pakette acil durdurma eylemi ve saha: PRO also includes emergency shutdown and physical site intervention capabilities.
Alarm, limit aşımı ve gün sonu üretim bi: Alarms, limit exceedances and daily generation updates via SMS, email, iOS and Android.
Gün sonu üretim bilgileri, anlık alarm d: Critical events, including daily generation updates, active alarms and limit exceedances, are delivered immediately.
Bildirimler SMS, e-posta ve iOS / Androi: Notifications are available through SMS, email and the iOS / Android apps.
Ekosistemin veri toplama ve işleme merke: The ecosystem’s data acquisition and processing hub
S3000i, ekosistemimizin veri toplama ve: S3000i is the foundation of data acquisition and processing in our ecosystem. It analyses and stores data from sensors and field devices, then transfers it to the ScadaWatt platform.
Karmaşık ve özel ihtiyaçlar için çok ama: A versatile device for complex, specialised requirements
S4000MC, daha karmaşık ve özel ihtiyaçla: S4000MC is a versatile device designed for complex, specialised requirements. Working alongside S3000i to collect and process data, it extends the available control scenarios.
LOMR-07H, şebeke arızası durumunda rölel: LOMR-07H triggers its relays when a grid fault occurs. Its relay outputs, together with control panels, allow the connection between the plant and the grid to be managed safely.
